manifest.name: SoundCloud
manifest.author: Parachord Team
manifest.requirement: Needs a SoundCloud account. Sign in from its panel.

account.signInHint: Sign in to search and stream SoundCloud
account.signedInNote: Streaming depends on each track’s permissions, which its uploader sets.

clientKeys.label: Client ID and secret
clientKeys.help: SoundCloud needs your own client ID and secret before you can sign in.
clientKeys.redirectHint: Add this to your SoundCloud app’s redirect URI. The same app also works with Parachord on Android and iOS.
clientKeys.redirectHintOtherPort: Add this to your SoundCloud app’s redirect URI. Parachord’s local server is on port {port}, so signing in to SoundCloud needs your own app credentials here: the built-in sign-in only works on port 8888. Parachord on Android and iOS always signs in on port 8888, so an app registered for port {port} won’t sign in on your phone.
